constraints.description: Advance Percentage for equities: maximum loan as % of collateral value
constraints.conditions: The bank may change the Advance and Margin Call Percentages at any time without notice
constraints.interpretation: Collateral-table row; columns are Advance Percentage, then Margin Call Percentage. The Borrowing Base is this % of the equity collateral's value, so borrowing capacity shrinks as markets fall.

constraints.description: Margin Call Percentage for equities: loan-to-value that triggers a call
constraints.interpretation: A call is due when the Outstanding Balance exceeds the Adjusted Collateral Value (this % of the equity collateral's value). The cure must bring the balance below the Borrowing Base (the advance rate).

constraints.description: Time to cure a collateral call
constraints.evidence_quote: (b) (i) If the Outstanding Balance exceeds at any time the Adjusted Collateral Value of the Eligible Collateral pledged to Bank then Pledgor shall have two (2) business days from the date notification (whether oral or written) of such noncompliance is delivered to Pledgor, to either pledge additional Eligible Collateral satisfactory to Bank, in its sole discretion, or reduce the Outstanding Balance such that, after giving effect thereto, the Outstanding Balance is less than the Borrowing Base as of the date on which such action is taken.
constraints.interpretation: Shorter than one month: the cure is due in the same simulated month as the call. If it is not met, the bank may sell collateral without further notice.
